BLANDALTMAN_PLOTDATA: Keep mode/scale/x-axis/plot selection, subject IDs and seed before Core Fit. BLANDALTMAN_ALLOWABLE_BIAS: Lower then upper finite conversions and lower>upper precedence precede fitting. The ByRef names assignment remains before option conversion/fitting failures. BLANDALTMAN_DECISION: Preserve allowable-bound conversion order, ByRef-name fitting, source Core assessment and every bias/LoA CI cache read in original cell order. LINCCC_FIT: Pair import/reset, three-row threshold, names and ordered alpha/CI/null/replicate options remain native. Extract x then y columns using the accepted Core matrix API, fit with the original seed path and stack the same Core reports. No concordance convention or default changes.
LINCCC_VALUE: Keep the original minimum three rows, fixed Reference/Test names, Core option defaults and seed. KAPPA_FIT: Categorical import preserves trimmed string labels, header symmetry and paired omission. KAPPA_VALUE: The same categorical/option/category-list sequence remains, using fixed Rater names and the existing Core weighted-kappa implementation. The scalar KappaCI estimate retains its original error/finite behavior; no hidden category normalization or GUI weighting correction is introduced.
ICC_FIT: Model/alpha/repeatability parsing precedes construction. One-way jagged groups and two-way complete matrices remain distinct; all six model cases, optional RC calls and type labels preserve order. Empty report-list handling stays Num and only the original first Core table is materialized.
ICC_VALUE: One-way versus two-way import and all six exact model selections are source/CIL bound. The scalar retains its explicit Nothing/NaN/Infinity guard after fitting, unlike other scalar agreement functions. No report-derived estimate, new model default or array normalization is substituted.
ICC_RC: Keep separate one-way/two-way imports and six exact repeatability argument combinations. Nothing still returns Num; the original CI cache, SEM field and title/header order move together into a typed Common ResultTable phase. Final materialization remains at the original Windows boundary.
CLASS_CONFUSION: Observed vector, probability vector, threshold, weights and includeHeader remain ordered before the same Core summary. Probability >= cutoff ties, class0/class1 ordering and percentages are unchanged. The report facade passes its original readonly host sentinel opaquely to Common; native conversion maps it to Excel NA.
CLASS_THRESH: Observe y,p, optional thresholds, weights and header in the original sequence. Existing Core threshold selection/order/tie behavior remains unchanged. The four-count and fourteen-column percent layout is fully copied to Common, preserving empty-row sentinel and final native Excel conversion.
CLASS_CALIB: Observed/probability inputs precede positive-bin parsing (default10,min2), calibration-method text, weights and header. Existing Core quantile/equal-width binning and weighted conventions remain unchanged. Report rows retain raw numeric NaN/Infinity interval values and six-column order; host error-text catch remains.
CLASS_BRIER: Binary validation remains explicitly before includeHeader conversion. CT_CHI2: Native numeric/count import, two-dimensional minimum and positive total guards remain before the prepared phase. CT_NOMINAL_ASSOC: Native import/shape/total guards remain ordered. Common reuses Chi2TESTindependence and only the original Item1 Nothing guard, deliberately adding no new finite checks to association coefficients. Cramer/Pearson/Phi row order and native BuildResultTable/Value catch stay unchanged.
CT_FISHER_2X2: The original Is2x2 failure stays Value, before the Core exact call with original row/column cell order. Only Pvalue receives the original finite guard. Exact lower/two-sided and mid-p fields retain their four-row order and native p-value formatting; no exact-test algorithm changes.
CT_FFH_EXACT: After original import, minimum shape and positive total checks, Common constructs/runs the same Core network engine. PObserved then PValue finite checks remain short-circuited through the original guard. Both raw cells return to native BuildResultTable; the distinct Num catch endpoint is preserved.
TryGetNumericMatrix: The entire unchanged adapter forwards the same input and all three ByRef outputs to TryReadNumericMatrix. Its dependency is supported by the retained C8 trimmed/numeric import source and real current CIL; no independent row/column inference or additional reset is introduced.
TryGetNumericVector: Reset values before missing/scalar handling; the scalar path allocates one double, otherwise Get2D transport normalizes supported array bounds. TryGetOptionalNumericVector: The whole adapter resets output before the missing check, succeeds with Nothing for missing input and otherwise forwards to the required vector reader. Source/CIL prove the complete short-circuit/reset path; it is not closed merely because it calls a shared API.
TryReadStrictNumericVectorFromSingleColu: Full original column loop is composed from the accepted TryStrictVector body under actual blank/numeric callbacks, with explicit arr(index,0) capture. Reset occurs before any observable callback; duplicate prepared reset has no intervening user-code observer. Tail trimming, optional first header, interior blank failure and final array assignment remain ordered.
TryReadStrictNumericVectorFromSingleRow: The original strict row loop maps to count=GetLength(1), arr(0,index) blank/numeric callbacks and the actual ByRef output alias. Source/CIL record both callback targets/captured array/constructors. No observer intervenes before the duplicate initial reset; all trimming/header/failure/success writes preserve their original order.
TryGetAlignedNumericWithOptionalCategory: Both one-column ranges and matching headers/row counts are validated before category acquisition. Header names are converted lazily. Only usable numeric pairs append x/y; an enabled category must be nonempty for each retained pair. requireCategory and final Nothing-versus-array category result remain exact.
TryGetCategoryList: Reset categories first; missing/blank text fails, comma splitting removes only empty entries and the exact Trim-to-Object lambda preserves order and duplicates. Row/column array paths keep source text conversion and blank omission; true matrices fail. Original/current lambda/cache/caller contexts are explicitly paired, not generically aliased.
TryGetPairedCategoricalColumns: Get2D for both arguments precedes one-column/equal-length checks and symmetric header policy. Names are lazily converted, then paired trimmed nonempty strings append together. Empty retained pairs return Num while shape/header failures return Value, with original array/string kinds preserved.
TryGetAlignedDemingInputs: Preserve x/y shape/header validation, lazy names, then optional SDx and SDy acquisition/header checks. Numeric pair selection precedes SD conversion on that retained row; missing required SD fails after local pair append. Final SD arrays remain Nothing when absent and are never inferred from variance choice.
TryGetOneWayIccGroups: Reset groups, acquire transport, trim last nonblank row/column, infer header and collect each row independently while skipping blanks. A nonnumeric nonblank cell fails immediately; require at least two nonempty groups and assign jagged arrays only on success. Unequal group lengths remain supported as originally.
FindLastNonBlankCol: Exact reverse column/forward row nested loops test the original native blank predicate and return the first qualifying column. Empty scan returns-1. Full source/CIL and integer loop bounds are unchanged; no eager header/text conversion occurs.
ParseAlphaOrDefault: Initialize the local alpha from caller default, call the original ByRef alpha parser and return only on success. Failure throws the exact ArgumentException text and remains caught by the original UDF boundary; no alpha clamping or fallback correction is added.
ParseOptionalNullableDouble: Missing returns Double.NaN; otherwise forward to the accepted optional-double reader with NaN default. Despite its name the return type remains Double, not Nullable. Full source/CIL retain culture and conversion exception behavior.
ParseOptionalSeed: Missing maps to Integer.MinValue, otherwise use the original optional-int conversion with the same sentinel. Both branches and conversion/overflow behavior are unchanged, so engine default/random handling is not silently replaced.
IsOneWayIcc: The complete original short-circuit comparison recognizes only ICC11 or ICC1K under the existing source comparison context. Model parsing and case/default policy remain in their accepted upstream parser; this unchanged adapter does not generalize text equivalence.
DescribeBlandAltmanScale: All five exact enum labels and the fallback enum.ToString branch are retained. No caller evaluates this description earlier; the allowable/decision report calls remain at their original row. Enum field values and current/original Core metadata are checked independently.
FitBlandAltmanFromUdfArgs: Aligned import errors and minimum pairs throw exact messages. ByRef names assignment precedes all original ordered options/validation, so partial state on later failure is preserved. Subject IDs and seed stay lazy; Core constructor and Fit retain their exact argument/state order and result type.
BuildBlandAltmanPlotDataTable: Preserve maximum observation/subject-mean row count, four exact headers, paired coordinate copy and explicit empty-string padding. Companion arrays are indexed in original order and may fail identically if inconsistent; no hidden shape repair, NaN conversion or header normalization occurs.
TryGetContingencyTable: Reset table, import numeric matrix and check positive dimensions, then allocate integer output before row-major finite/nonnegative/rounded/tolerance checks. CInt conversion and partial output on failure/overflow remain original; no count correction, transpose or marginal normalization is introduced.
ConvertBinaryClassificationOutputForExce: First map the original host singleton by reference to Excel NA; otherwise preserve nonmatrix values. For a matrix, allocate a fresh zero-based output and map each sentinel row-major without changing other cell references/types. No numerical, blank or finite conversion is added.
